settings.help.terminal-animations: Disables window open animations in the main menu terminal UI. Background and hazard stripes keep moving.
settings.help.item-auto-select: When enabled, newly picked-up items are selected automatically in the inventory hotbar.
settings.help.inventory-scroll: Clamp stops at the first and last slot. Loop wraps from last to first when scrolling the inventory.
settings.help.optimistic-network-terrain: Applies terrain edits on your machine before the server confirms them. Can feel smoother online but may desync until the server agrees.
settings.help.third-person-view-walking: Shows your character model while moving on foot instead of a first-person view only.
settings.help.third-person-view-seat: Shows your character model while seated in a vehicle or mount.
settings.help.screen-shake: Scales how strong camera shake is from explosions, impacts, and similar effects.
settings.help.controls.look-sensitivity: Multiplier for mouse and stick look speed. Lower is slower; higher is faster.
settings.help.simulation-distance: How far from you creatures and simulation stay active. Higher costs more CPU.
settings.help.custom-cursor: Uses the game custom cursor in menus instead of the system default pointer.
settings.help.graphics.fps-cap: Limits rendered frames per second. Zero means unlimited (as fast as your GPU allows).
settings.help.graphics.antialiasing: Smooths jagged edges. Higher quality modes cost more GPU time.
settings.help.graphics.lod-bias: Scales level-of-detail distance. Higher values draw more detail farther away.
settings.help.sprint-mode: How sprint is activated: hybrid (tap/hold), hold only, or toggle.
settings.help.crouch-mode: How crouch is activated: hybrid (tap/hold), hold only, or toggle.
settings.help.graphics.decals: Enables bullet holes, marks, and similar surface decals.
settings.help.graphics.bloom: Adds a glow around bright areas. Costs GPU time when enabled.
settings.help.graphics.color-grading: Applies color grading and tonemapping for the HDR look.
settings.help.graphics.shadows: Renders real-time shadows from sun and local lights.
settings.help.graphics.ambient-occlusion: Darkens creases and contact points for extra depth.
settings.help.graphics.fog: Distance fog that fades distant scenery into the atmosphere.
settings.help.graphics.volumetric-fog: Volumetric fog with light scattering (heavier than screen fog).
settings.help.graphics.field-of-view: Horizontal field of view in degrees while on foot.
settings.help.graphics.terrain-details: Shows terrain detail meshes (rocks, clutter) on the ground.
settings.help.graphics.terrain-grass: Renders grass and similar terrain foliage.
settings.help.vehicle-volume: Engines, tires, and other vehicle sounds.
settings.help.weather-volume: Rain, wind, thunder, and weather ambience.
settings.help.weapon-volume: Gunfire, reloads, and weapon handling sounds.
settings.help.interface-volume: UI clicks, notifications, and menu sounds.
settings.help.object-volume: World objects, doors, and interactable props.
settings.help.language: UI and subtitle language for the game.
settings.help.input-mode-hybrid: Tap once to toggle; hold for momentary action when supported.
settings.help.input-mode-hold: Action stays active only while the button is held.
settings.help.input-mode-toggle: Each press toggles the action on or off.
